name: Basic activity trail
summary: A minimal activity trail over entity, identity, and access events. Superseded by audit.history, which adds before/after values, tamper evidence, retention policy, redaction, and export. Capabilities requiring a defensible record (ai.agents, support.impersonation) declare audit.history as a hard dependency rather than relying on this.

requires.reason: The trail is built by subscribing to the bus.

owns.name: AuditEntry
owns.description: The shared audit primitive. Only the kernel may define it.

privacy.retention_note: Retained as the record of processing. The actor reference is anonymised with the user rather than the entry being deleted.

enhances.unlocks: permission-gated access to the activity view; the audit.read permission is registered only when an access capability is present

consumes.name: entity.*
consumes.reason: record creation, update, and deletion of every entity

consumes.name: identity.*
consumes.reason: record logins, session lifecycle, and account changes

exposes.name: record
exposes.description: audit.history must satisfy this signature to upgrade this capability.

smoke.name: entity change is recorded
smoke.asserts: creating an entity produces an audit entry naming the actor and the entity

smoke.name: entries are immutable
smoke.asserts: an update or delete against an audit entry is rejected at the repository layer
